sentences.text: South Australia’s Independent Commission Against Corruption examined corruption risks arising from lobbying public officials and the effectiveness of the state’s regulatory scheme.
sentences.support: This report examines corruption risks associated with lobbying and influencing activity aimed at public officials in South Australia

sentences.text: The Commission considered the scope of regulation, transparency, former officials’ lobbying, local government and administration of the scheme.
sentences.support: identified limitations in the scope of the scheme, the regulation of lobbied parties

sentences.text: The Commission concluded that the scheme exposed only a small proportion of influencing activity to public scrutiny.
sentences.support: In its present form the regulatory scheme in this state admits only a shaft of light on a small part of influencing activity.

sentences.text: Its 31 recommendations proposed broader coverage, disclosure of lobbying contacts, restrictions after public office, local government coverage and oversight by the Ombudsman.
sentences.support: That the scheme created by the Lobbyists Act and Lobbyists Regulations should be regulated and administered by the Ombudsman.

findings.quote: Transparency is the best measure to combat the corruption risks associated with influencing activity.

notes: No separate executive summary or overview. The conclusion and recommendations are used; case studies and external submissions are not treated as findings about South Australian individuals.
